role_evidence.quote: A Phase II, Investigator-Initiated Study of Imipramine Hydrochloride and Lomustine in Recurrent Glioblastoma
For both cohorts, lomustine will be administered as 110 mg/m2 PO once every 6 weeks.

coder_notes: Single-arm trial; lomustine at standard recurrent-GBM dose given to every patient, coded soc_backbone, imipramine is the investigational agent. Surgical cohort exists but no tumour drug-level or pharmacodynamic measurement is registered (only PFS outcome). Ages include CHILD but inclusion requires age >= 18.
